cases.purpose: Check lifecycle polling slow against a local CA
cases.oracle: Local CA records monotonic response times, status, retry headers, accepted CSR, output, and responder cleanup; cryptography verifies the positive issued key and certificate.
cases.comparison: Positive controls must issue a valid signed chain while respecting each delay; failure controls must stop without publishing output or leaking the listener.
